description: Interface language, execution mode, company profile and the connection to the backend

language.description: Vietnamese is always the primary label language; the English build is a preview for cross-checking terms.

executionMode.description: Decides where AI models run. Orchestration data, tasks and logs always stay on your machine in every mode.

local.title: Run on your machine
local.body: AI models run through Ollama locally. Nothing leaves the machine; speed depends on your hardware.

cloud.title: Call cloud models
cloud.body: Uses Anthropic Claude through the API. Highest reasoning quality; needs network access and an API key.

hybrid.title: Combine local and cloud
hybrid.body: Routine work runs locally; complex or quality-critical work goes to the cloud. Balances cost, speed and privacy.

company.title: Company profile
company.description: Shown in the header, the greeting and reports produced by AI agents.
company.name: Company name

backend.title: Backend connection
backend.description: The interface reads everything from a single source and receives realtime updates.
backend.refreshed: Reloaded the full snapshot from the backend
backend.resetConfirmBody: Every current task, approval, message and log entry will be replaced by the original sample data. This cannot be undone.

standard.title: UI language standard
standard.description: Every screen follows the same rules so Vietnamese users understand immediately while still learning the original terms.
rules: Vietnamese is the default language of the whole interface; English is a preview only.
Every English industry term is paired with its Vietnamese meaning – on one line or as a smaller second line.
AI job titles are shown in full, e.g. AI CEO – Giám đốc điều hành AI.
Brand names and technical identifiers (Meta Ads, Google Ads, Zalo OA, error codes) are never translated.
Content produced by AI agents (task titles, messages, reports) is data and is displayed verbatim.
standard.link: Look up terms in the Knowledge Base
